description: This file contains type definitions, structures, and interface specifications for Type1/Type2 font encoding and font data used in the FreeType project, including font and encoding structures, font info, and face classes.

classes.name: T1_FaceRec
classes.description: Structure representing a Type1 font face, including font info, encoding, and optional support for multiple masters and PostScript hinter.

classes.name: CID_FaceRec
classes.description: Structure representing a CID font face with CID-specific data and PostScript hinter support.
